617:t_127:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I am a $$次元将$$! I will keep fighting until my life runs out!!」

617:t_128:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_128:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「To protect the world... and the potential of humankind...」

617:t_128:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「And to keep my promise to $$オードリー$$!」

617:t_128:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「The former, I can allow. The latter, I cannot understand.」

617:t_128:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I can't understand you either! You, who dragged this world into the fighting!」

617:t_128:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「If we cannot understand each other...」

617:t_128:6.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Why can't you see how pointless it is to settle things by force like that!」

617:t_128:7.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「What the universe demands is power! A species that cannot accept that is destined only to perish!」

617:t_128:8.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Even so! I reject a world like that!!」

617:t_129:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_129:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「Carving out the future...! That is my fight!」

617:t_129:3.en:
$$刹那$$
「Being an $$イノベイター$$ has nothing to do with it! I fight as one human living in this world... as a human who wishes for peace!」

617:t_129:4.en:
$$刹那$$
「$$次元将ヴィルダーク#pilot$$! Humanity will surpass you!」

617:t_129:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Offer up that power, that will, that resolve! Neither you nor humanity will ever advance beyond this point!」

617:t_130:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_130:1.en:
$$シン$$
「I'll end the war! That's why I fight!」

617:t_130:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Pointless. A species evolves through struggle.」

617:t_130:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Just as I will gain new power by defeating you!」

617:t_130:4.en:
$$シン$$
「Don't drag this world into your selfish logic!」

617:t_130:5.en:
$$シン$$
「If you want a fight that badly, I'll be your opponent! And I'll put an end to you here!」

617:t_131:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_131:1.en:
$$キラ$$
「For everyone...! That's why I fight!」

617:t_131:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That abstract answer is not what I want to hear.」

617:t_131:3.en:
$$キラ$$
「What comes after that is for each person to decide! That's why I protect this world's freedom!」

617:t_131:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That resolve... Is it genuine?」

617:t_131:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「It is by defeating such a warrior that I rise to greater heights!」

617:t_131:6.en:
$$キラ$$
「I have no intention of joining your fight!」

617:t_131:7.en:
$$キラ$$
「I'll end this fight here! By joining the feelings and strength entrusted to me as one!」

617:t_132:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_132:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「The man I was before would have answered that it was to atone.」

617:t_132:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「But not anymore! I will fight for the Earth and for everyone in space as well!」

617:t_132:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「This man has shaken off his doubts!」

617:t_132:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That is exactly what I wanted! I acknowledge you as a strong one!!」

617:t_133:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_133:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「If you want to know that badly, I'll tell you. It's for peace.」

617:t_133:5.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Someone who can't even see the value of that commonplace thing... That is you.」

617:t_133:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Very well, warrior. There is some truth in your words.」

617:t_133:7.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But your wish will not be granted! What the universe demands is battle!」

617:t_133:8.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I have no intention of obeying that logic...!」

617:t_134:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_134:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「What meaning is there in asking that?」

617:t_134:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「To determine whether you are a warrior worthy of standing before me.」

617:t_134:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Sizing up other people... You are an unpleasant man to the very end.」

617:t_134:4.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Then I'll answer you! I fight to crush filthy power like yours!」

617:t_134:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Good! Your fighting spirit... and your resolve are genuine!」

617:t_135:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_135:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「To protect what's precious to me! That's why I chose to fight!」

617:t_135:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Carrying your feelings on those wings, you fly the skies of battle...!」

617:t_135:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Then I will break those wings and strike you down to the ground!」

617:t_135:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「Like hell I'll let you! My wings are my soul!」

617:t_135:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'm not going to let a man like you take my soul from me!」

617:t_136:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_136:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That power of life...! I will make it mine!!」

617:t_137:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_137:1.en:
$$レド$$
「On this planet, I learned the true meaning of living!」

617:t_137:2.en:
$$レド$$
「Whoever takes that away...! That person is my enemy!」

617:t_137:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Hardly the answer I would expect from the mindset of a member of the $$人類銀河同盟$$.」

617:t_137:4.en:
$$レド$$
「I'm a human before I'm a soldier...! I'm a living being!」

617:t_137:5.en:
$$レド$$
「I'll fight whoever takes that away! Together with my comrades!」

617:t_137:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「You grasped the truth and gained power, then...」

617:t_137:7.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Overcoming that is what makes a $$次元将$$! Human, show me that power!」

617:t_138:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_138:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「Can you afford to ask questions like that?」

617:t_138:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「I don't know what's behind it, but you're a dictator on the edge of a cliff, cornered and forced to kill your own subordinates!」

617:t_138:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「I won't give you a chance to turn this around! It ends here!」

617:t_138:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I have come to understand what kind of man you are...」

617:t_138:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But I will not let you have your way! Your fighting spirit and resolve, I will crush-」

617:t_138:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「The time for talk ended long ago! Has-been dictator!!」

617:t_139:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_139:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I understand now. You are the same as me.」
